40023238.author: पदार्थः
40023238.content: अध्यर्धयोजनं one and a half yojanas, गत्वा having gone, नदीं river, पश्चान्मुखाश्रिताम् flowing westward, सरयूं Sarayu, पुण्यसलिलां with sacred waters, ददर्श saw, रघुनन्दनः Rama.

40023238.author: Translation
40023238.content: Having traveled one and a half yojanas, Rama saw the sacred-watered Sarayu river, which flowed westward.

40023239.author: पदार्थः
40023239.content: ताम् that, नदीम् river, आकुलावर्ताम् with agitated whirlpools, सर्वत्र everywhere, अनुसरन् following, नृपः the king, आगतः arrived, सप्रजः with his people, रामः Rama, तम् that, देशम् place, रघुनन्दनः the delight of the Raghus.

40023239.author: Translation
40023239.content: King Rama, the delight of the Raghus, arrived at that place with his people, following that river which had agitated whirlpools everywhere.

40023240.author: पदार्थः
40023240.content: अथ then, तस्मिन् at that, मुहूर्ते moment, तु indeed, ब्रह्मा Brahma, लोकपितामहः the grandfather of the worlds, सर्वैः by all, परिवृतः surrounded, देवैः by gods, ऋषिभिः by sages, च and, महात्मभिः great-souled.

40023240.author: Translation
40023240.content: Then, at that very moment, Brahma, the grandfather of the worlds, arrived, surrounded by all the gods and great-souled sages.

40023241.author: पदार्थः
40023241.content: आययौ came, यत्र where, काकुत्स्थः Kakutstha (Rama), स्वर्गाय for heaven, समुपस्थितः was ready, विमानशतकोटीभिः by hundreds of crores of celestial chariots, दिव्याभिः divine, अभिसंवृतः surrounded.

40023241.author: Translation
40023241.content: Brahma came to where Rama was ready to ascend to heaven, surrounded by hundreds of crores of divine celestial chariots.

40023242.author: पदार्थः
40023242.content: दिव्यतेजोवृतम् covered with divine splendor, व्योम the sky, ज्योतिर्भूतम् became luminous, अनुत्तमम् unsurpassed, स्वयम्प्रभैः self-luminous, स्वतेजोभिः by their own radiance, स्वर्गिभिः by the dwellers of heaven, पुण्यकर्मभिः by those of meritorious deeds.

40023242.author: Translation
40023242.content: The sky became an unsurpassed, luminous expanse, covered with divine splendor, shining with the self-luminous radiance of the meritorious dwellers of heaven.

40023243.author: पदार्थः
40023243.content: पुण्याः sacred, वाताः winds, ववुः blew, च and, एव indeed, गन्धवन्तः fragrant, सुखप्रदाः bringing comfort, पपात fell, पुष्पवृष्टिः a shower of flowers, च and, देवैः by the gods, मुक्ता released, महौघवत् like a great flood.

40023243.author: Translation
40023243.content: Sacred, fragrant, and comforting winds blew, and a shower of flowers, released by the gods, fell like a great flood.

40023244.author: पदार्थः
40023244.content: तस्मिन् in that (place/moment), तूर्यशतैः by hundreds of musical instruments, कीर्णे filled, गन्धर्वाप्सरसङ्कुले crowded with Gandharvas and Apsaras, सरयूसलिलम् the waters of Sarayu, रामः Rama, पद्भ्याम् with his feet, समुपचक्रमे approached.

40023244.author: Translation
40023244.content: In that place, filled with hundreds of musical instruments and crowded with Gandharvas and Apsaras, Rama approached the waters of the Sarayu river with his feet.

40023245.author: पदार्थः
40023245.content: ततः then, पितामहः the Grandfather (Brahma), वाणीम् a voice, अन्तरिक्षात् from the sky, अभाषत spoke, आगच्छ come, विष्णो O Vishnu, भद्रम् welfare, ते to you, दिष्ट्या fortunately, प्राप्तः असि you have arrived, राघव O Raghava.

40023245.author: Translation
40023245.content: Then, the Grandfather Brahma spoke a voice from the sky, saying, "Come, O Vishnu, may good fortune be with you; fortunately, you have arrived, O Raghava."

40023246.author: पदार्थः
40023246.content: भ्रातृभिः with your brothers, सह together, देवाभैः who resemble gods, प्रविशस्व enter, स्विकाम् your own, तनुम् body, याम् which, इच्छसि you desire, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, ताम् that, तनुम् body, प्रविश enter, स्विकाम् your own, वैष्णवीम् Vishnu's (form), ताम् that, महातेजः O greatly effulgent one, तत् that, वा or, आकाशम् the sky, सनातनम् eternal.

40023246.author: Translation
40023246.content: O mighty-armed and greatly effulgent one, enter your own desired form, whether it be with your god-like brothers into your own body, or into that Vaishnava form, or into the eternal sky.

40023247.author: पदार्थः
40023247.content: त्वम् you, हि indeed, लोकगतिः the refuge of the worlds, देव O God, न not, त्वाम् you, केचित् anyone, प्रजानते knows, ऋते except, मायाम् Maya, विशालाक्षीम् the wide-eyed one, तव your, पूर्वपरिग्रहाम् previously accepted, त्वाम् you, अचिन्त्यम् inconceivable, महद्भूतम् the great being, अक्षयम् imperishable, सर्वसङ्ग्रहम् the container of all.

40023247.author: Translation
40023247.content: O God, you are indeed the refuge of the worlds, and no one truly knows you, except for your previously accepted wide-eyed Maya, who knows you as the inconceivable, great, imperishable being, the container of all.

40023248.author: पदार्थः
40023248.content: याम् which, इच्छसि you desire, महातेजः O greatly effulgent one, ताम् that, तनुम् body, प्रविश enter, स्वयम् yourself.

40023248.author: Translation
40023248.content: O greatly effulgent one, enter that form which you yourself desire.

40023249.author: पदार्थः
40023249.content: विशालाक्षीं Visalakshi (Sita), तव your, पूर्वपरिग्रहाम् former wife, पितामहवचः grandfather's words, श्रुत्वा having heard, विनिश्चित्य having decided, महामतिः the great-minded one (Rama), विवेश entered, वैष्णवं Vishnu's, तेजः effulgence, सशरीरः with his body, सहानुजः with his younger brothers.

40023249.author: Translation
40023249.content: Having heard and understood the words of his grandfather Brahma regarding Visalakshi (Sita), the great-minded Rama, along with his body and younger brothers, entered into the divine effulgence of Vishnu.

40023250.author: पदार्थः
40023250.content: ततो then, विष्णुमयं Vishnu-incarnate, देवं god, पूजयन्ति स्म worshipped, देवताः the gods, साध्या Sadhyas, मरुद्गणाश्चैव and the Maruts, सेन्द्राः with Indra, साग्निपुरोगमाः with Agni as their leader.

40023250.author: Translation
40023250.content: Then, the gods, including the Sadhyas, the Maruts, Indra, and those led by Agni, worshipped the deity who had become one with Vishnu.

40023251.author: पदार्थः
40023251.content: ये च and those, दिव्या divine, ऋषिगणा groups of sages, गन्धर्वाप्सरसश्च and Gandharvas and Apsaras, याः who, सुपर्णनागयक्षाश्च and Suparnas, Nagas, and Yakshas, दैत्यदानवराक्षसाः Daityas, Danavas, and Rakshasas.

40023251.author: Translation
40023251.content: All the divine groups of sages, Gandharvas, Apsaras, Suparnas, Nagas, Yakshas, Daityas, Danavas, and Rakshasas were also present.

40023252.author: पदार्थः
40023252.content: सर्वं all, पुष्टं nourished, प्रमुदितं greatly delighted, सुसम्पूर्णमनोरथम् with all desires completely fulfilled, साधु साध्विति saying "Excellent! Excellent!", तैर्देवैः by those gods, त्रिदिवं heaven, गतकल्मषम् free from sin.

40023252.author: Translation
40023252.content: All were nourished, greatly delighted, and had their desires completely fulfilled, as the gods exclaimed "Excellent! Excellent!" and heaven became free from all blemish.

40023253.author: पदार्थः
40023253.content: अथ then, विष्णुः Vishnu, महातेजाः the greatly effulgent one, पितामहमुवाच ह indeed spoke to Brahma, एषां to these, लोकं world, जनौघानां of the multitudes of people, दातुमर्हसि you ought to give, सुव्रत O one of good vows.

40023253.author: Translation
40023253.content: Then, the greatly effulgent Vishnu addressed Brahma, the one of good vows, saying, "You ought to grant an abode to these multitudes of people."

40023254.author: पदार्थः
40023254.content: इमे these, हि indeed, सर्वे all, स्नेहात् out of affection, माम् me, अनुयाताः have followed, यशस्विनः glorious ones, भक्ताः devotees, हि indeed, भजितव्याः to be honored, च and, त्यक्तात्मानः those who have given up their selves, च and, मत्कृते for my sake.

40023254.author: Translation
40023254.content: These glorious ones, all of whom have followed me out of affection, are indeed my devotees who have sacrificed their very selves for my sake and thus deserve to be honored.

40023255.author: पदार्थः
40023255.content: तत् that, श्रुत्वा having heard, विष्णुवचनम् Vishnu's words, ब्रह्मा Brahma, लोकगुरुः the preceptor of the worlds, प्रभुः the lord, लोकान् worlds, सान्तानिकान् named Santanika, नाम named, यास्यन्ति will go, इमे these, समागताः who have assembled.

40023255.author: Translation
40023255.content: Having heard those words of Vishnu, Lord Brahma, the preceptor of the worlds, declared that all these assembled beings would go to the worlds named Santanika.

40023256.author: पदार्थः
40023256.content: यत् whatever, च and, तिर्यग्गतम् born as an animal, किञ्चित् anything, त्वाम् you, एवम् thus, अनुचिन्तयत् meditating upon, प्राणान् life, त्यक्ष्यति will abandon, भक्त्या with devotion, वै indeed, तत्सन्ताने in that Santanika world, निवत्स्यति will reside.

40023256.author: Translation
40023256.content: And whatever animal, meditating upon you in this manner, abandons its life with devotion, will indeed reside in that Santanika world.

40023257.author: पदार्थः
40023257.content: सर्वैः with all, ब्रह्मगुणैः divine qualities, युक्ते endowed, ब्रह्मलोकात् from the world of Brahma, अनन्तरे next/not different.

40023257.author: Translation
40023257.content: This refers to the Santanika world, which is endowed with all divine qualities and is next to or not different from the world of Brahma.

40023258.author: पदार्थः
40023258.content: वानराः monkeys, च and, स्विकाम् their own, योनिम् origin/form, ऋक्षाः bears, च and, एव indeed, तथा similarly, ययुः went, येभ्यः from whom, विनिस्सृताः originated, सर्वे all, सुरेभ्यः from the gods, सुरसम्भवाः born of gods.

40023258.author: Translation
40023258.content: The monkeys and bears, who were all born of gods and had originated from them, returned to their respective divine forms.

40023259.author: पदार्थः
40023259.content: तेषु among them, प्रविविशे entered, चैव and indeed, सुग्रीवः Sugriva, सूर्यमण्डलम् the solar orb, पश्यतां while seeing, सर्वदेवानां of all the gods, स्वान् their own, पितऽन् ancestors, प्रतिपेदिरे attained,

40023259.author: Translation
40023259.content: Among them, Sugriva entered the solar orb, and all the gods, while watching, attained their own ancestors.

40023260.author: पदार्थः
40023260.content: तथा thus, उक्तवति having spoken, देवेशे by the lord of gods, गोप्रतारम् to Gopratara, उपागताः having arrived, भेजिरे resorted to, सरयूं the Sarayu river, सर्वे all, हर्षपूर्णाश्रुविक्लवाः overwhelmed with tears full of joy,

40023260.author: Translation
40023260.content: When the lord of gods had thus spoken, all those who had arrived at Gopratara, overwhelmed with tears of joy, entered the Sarayu river.

40023261.author: पदार्थः
40023261.content: अवगाह्य having plunged into, जलं the water, यो यः whoever, प्राणी living being, ह्यासीत् indeed was, प्रहृष्टवत् greatly delighted, मानुषं human, देहम् body, उत्सृज्य having abandoned, विमानं a celestial chariot, सो he, ऽध्यरोहत ascended,

40023261.author: Translation
40023261.content: Whoever living being, greatly delighted, plunged into the water, abandoned their human body and ascended a celestial chariot.

40023262.author: पदार्थः
40023262.content: तिर्यग्योनिगतानां of those born in animal wombs, च and, शतानि hundreds, सरयूजलम् the water of Sarayu, सम्प्राप्य having attained, त्रिदिवं heaven, जग्मुः went, प्रभासुरवपूंषि with radiant bodies, च and, दिव्या divine beings, दिव्येन with divine, वपुषा bodies, देवा gods, दीप्ता shining, इवाभवन् as if became,

40023262.author: Translation
40023262.content: And hundreds of animals, having attained the water of Sarayu, went to heaven with radiant bodies, becoming like shining gods with divine forms.

40023263.author: पदार्थः
40023263.content: गत्वा having gone, तु indeed, सरयूतोयम् to the water of Sarayu, स्थावराणि immobile beings, चराणि mobile beings, च and, प्राप्य having obtained, तत्तोयविक्लेदं the moistening by that water, देवलोकम् the world of gods, उपागमन् attained,

40023263.author: Translation
40023263.content: Indeed, having gone to the water of Sarayu, both immobile and mobile beings, by obtaining the moistening from that water, attained the world of gods.

40023264.author: पदार्थः
40023264.content: तस्मिन्नपि in that (place/time) also, समापन्नाः arrived, ऋक्षवानरराक्षसाः bears, monkeys, and rakshasas, ते they, अपि also, स्वर्गं heaven, प्रविविशुः entered, देहान् bodies, निक्षिप्य having cast off, च and, अम्भसि in water.

40023264.author: Translation
40023264.content: Even the bears, monkeys, and rakshasas who had gathered there, having cast off their bodies in the water, also entered heaven.

40023265.author: पदार्थः
40023265.content: ततः thereafter, समागतान् those who had gathered, सर्वान् all, स्थाप्य having established, लोकगुरुः the preceptor of the worlds (Rama), दिवि in heaven, जगाम went, त्रिदशैः with the gods, सार्धं together with, सदा always, हृष्टैः joyful, दिवं to heaven, महत् great.

40023265.author: Translation
40023265.content: Thereafter, the preceptor of the worlds, Rama, having established all those who had gathered in heaven, went to the great heaven along with the ever-joyful gods. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे दशाधिकशततमः सर्गः ।। 110 ।। Thus ends the hundred and tenth sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
